accepted_claims: No universal finite cone-test radius across supplied finite markings, already on a fixed-two-generator filling family.
No manifold-only radius valid for every finite marking of the Weeks group.
Effective marked sufficient radius is equivalent to left-orderability decidability under a uniform word-problem algorithm.
audit_code_scope: Read-only byte/inventory verification and regression tests only
nonblocking_clarifications: Uniform word-problem solving is available for promised finite 3-manifold-group presentations, without an extra solver oracle.
The girth proof uses words with inverses; its k+2 construction gives a bounded tuple size, although the author does not need that strengthening.
Kernel exclusion through length 3r is sufficient and sharp in general; ball injectivity alone is insufficient.
